steps.code:
r = primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=10, prompt='open gripper to retry')
print('open', r.ok)
r = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', prompt='rose on table')
print('locate', r.ok)
if r.ok:
    h = r.output.get('evidence_handle')
    print(h, r.output.get('world_target'))
r = primitives.call(name='grasp_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', evidence_handles=[h], max_n_substep=4, prompt='grasp rose stem')
print('grasp', r.ok, r.output.get('stage_ok') if r.ok else r)
r = primitives.call(name='settle_vlabench_scene', horizon=5, hold_gripper_state=0.0, prompt='settle grasp')
print('settle', r.ok)
r3 = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='after grasp')
if r3.ok:
    g = r3.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
    print('grasped', str(g.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:60])
    print('rose', g.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {}).get('xpos'))
    print('ee', str(r3.output.get('ee_state'))[:120])

steps.title: vlabench scene · open vlabench gripper · locate vlabench entity
steps.code:
r = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='inspect rose grasp sites')
ev = r.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {}).get('entity_evidence', {}) if r.ok else {}
rose = ev.get('rose', {})
print('rose xpos', rose.get('xpos'), 'grasp', rose.get('grasp_sites'), 'bbox', rose.get('bbox_world'))
vase = ev.get('vase_seen', {})
print('vase xpos', vase.get('xpos'), 'place', vase.get('place_points'), 'key', vase.get('key_sites'))
r = primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=10, prompt='open gripper')
print('open', r.ok)
r = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', prompt='rose on table')
h = r.output.get('evidence_handle') if r.ok else None
print('handle', h, r.output.get('world_target') if r.ok else r)
gs = rose.get('grasp_sites')
tp = None
if isinstance(gs, list) and len(gs) > 0 and isinstance(gs[0], list) and len(gs[0]) == 3 and all(isinstance(x, (int, float)) for x in gs[0]):
    tp = [float(gs[0][0]), float(gs[0][1]), float(gs[0][2])]
print('grasp target', tp)
if tp is not None:
    r = primitives.call(name='grasp_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', evidence_handles=[h], target_position=tp, max_n_substep=4, prompt='grasp rose at grasp site')
else:
    r = primitives.call(name='grasp_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', evidence_handles=[h], max_n_substep=4, prompt='grasp rose')
print('grasp', r.ok, r.output.get('stage_ok') if r.ok else r)
r = primitives.call(name='settle_vlabench_scene', horizon=5, hold_gripper_state=0.0, prompt='settle')
r = primitives.call(name='lift_vlabench_ee', evidence_handles=[h], lift_height=0.15, gripper_state=0.0, prompt='lift rose')
print('lift', r.ok)
r3 = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='after lift')
if r3.ok:
    g = r3.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
    print('grasped', str(g.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:60])
    print('rose', g.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {}).get('xpos'))

steps.title: open vlabench gripper · vlabench scene · locate vlabench entity
steps.code:
def atan_(t):
    # arctan via series with range reduction
    neg = t < 0
    t = -t if neg else t
    inv = t > 1.0
    if inv:
        t = 1.0 / t
    # further reduce
    s = 0.0
    while t > 0.2679:  # tan(15deg)
        t = (t * 1.7320508 - 1.0) / (t + 1.7320508)
        s += 0.5235988
    t2 = t * t
    term = t; acc = 0.0; n = 1
    for i in range(20):
        acc += term / n
        term = -term * t2
        n += 2
    a = acc + s
    if inv:
        a = 1.5707963 - a
    return -a if neg else a

def atan2_(y, x):
    if x > 0:
        return atan_(y / x)
    if x < 0:
        return atan_(y / x) + (3.14159265 if y >= 0 else -3.14159265)
    return 1.5707963 if y > 0 else -1.5707963

r = primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=10, prompt='open gripper')
r = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='rose pose')
ev = r.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {}).get('entity_evidence', {})
rose = ev.get('rose', {})
xp = rose.get('xpos'); gs = rose.get('grasp_sites')[0]
print('rose', xp, 'gs', gs)
dx = gs[0] - xp[0]; dy = gs[1] - xp[1]
yaw_stem = atan2_(dy, dx)
yaw = yaw_stem + 1.5707963
print('stem yaw', yaw_stem, 'grip yaw', yaw)
r = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', prompt='rose on table')
h = r.output.get('evidence_handle')
tp = [float(gs[0]), float(gs[1]), float(gs[2])]
r = primitives.call(name='grasp_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', evidence_handles=[h], target_position=tp, target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, yaw], max_n_substep=4, prompt='grasp rose stem perpendicular')
print('grasp', r.ok, r.output.get('stage_ok') if r.ok else r, str(r.output.get('last_waypoint'))[:120] if r.ok else '')
r = primitives.call(name='settle_vlabench_scene', horizon=5, hold_gripper_state=0.0, prompt='settle')
r3 = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='after grasp')
g = r3.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
print('grasped', str(g.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:60])
print('rose', g.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {}).get('xpos'))

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
for z in [1.16, 1.12]:
    r = primitives.call(name='move_vlabench_ee_to', evidence_handles=[vh], horizon=15, target_position=[0.215, 0.152, z], target_euler=[1.5708, 0.0, 2.9899], gripper_state=0.0, prompt='lower stem deeper into vase')
    r3 = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='check')
    g = r3.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
    rz = g.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {})
    print('z', z, 'ee', r.output.get('end_ee_position') if r.ok else r, 'rose', rz.get('xpos'), 'grasped', str(g.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:20])
r = primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=15, prompt='release rose into vase')
print('open', r.ok)
r = primitives.call(name='settle_vlabench_scene', horizon=20, prompt='let rose settle')
r3 = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', prompt='after release')
g = r3.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
rz = g.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {})
print('rose', rz.get('xpos'), 'grasp', rz.get('grasp_sites'), 'grasped', str(g.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:20])
